records.purpose: Represent mental-health symptoms, development, physical health and functional outcomes within the EDHT Digital Twin.
records.scope: Existing Twin owns versioned source-scoped simulations and longitudinal projections. Patient, organ, physician, hospital and population subject kinds remain explicit and separate. Clinical records, professional identity, organizational operations and research data retain their own authoritative owners; none can be overwritten by a simulation. Source-specific scope: Pediatric Mental Health Digital Twin & Longitudinal Functional Modeling Module
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded twin-remaining-projections artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain subject kind/binding, observed versus simulated states, assumptions, input/model/scenario versions, uncertainty and valid-use domain. Source correction or permission changes invalidate dependent projections. No treatment, staffing or coercive action is authorized by a projected outcome.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve recipient verification, payload version, consent basis, expiry and delivery/acknowledgement distinction. Test retries, duplicates, unverified endpoints and stale messages; do not infer staffed response from a delivery receipt.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.clinical_safety: No credential, directory membership, risk score or clinical model can grant treatment authority or unrestricted patient access. Fail closed for the non-emergency MVP read; do not claim emergency response, clinical clearance or certification.
records.privacy: Purpose-limited minimum disclosure with separate tenant/patient/recipient checks, guardian/adolescent restrictions and protected credential/audit metadata. No raw bearer tokens, biometric samples or unrestricted health payloads in logs.
records.failure_modes: Unknown, expired, revoked, contradictory or unavailable identity/role/grant/source yields denial or explicit unavailable state. Preserve source history and idempotent correction; never silently expand permissions on retry.
records.acceptance: Preserve country/provider, referral status, source freshness, language and consent constraints. Require verified receiving-provider arrangements and permitted disclosure; international naming alone never establishes jurisdictional compliance or service availability.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
